name: nanai-flow-bot
description: n8n + Telegram + OpenCode automation bot workspace

scripts.validate:workflows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path './n8n/workflows' -Filter '*.json' | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }; Write-Host 'workflow json ok'"
scripts.validate:scripts: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Management.Automation; Get-ChildItem -Path './scripts' -Filter '*.ps1' | ForEach-Object { $t=$null; $e=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($_.FullName,[ref]$t,[ref]$e) | Out-Null; if($e.Count -gt 0){ throw $e[0].Message } }; Write-Host 'powershell scripts ok'"
scripts.check: npm run validate:workflows && npm run validate:scripts
